why.D: Wish is what a person hopes will happen; an omen is a hint of what will happen whether anyone hopes for it or not.

why.A: 0 would mean no fold matches the rectangle onto itself, but a fold through the middle of the long sides does, and so does a fold through the middle of the short sides.
why.B: 1 counts only the fold across the middle from side to side and misses the fold from top to bottom.
